cohort: 112 healthy term newborn babies (58 males, 54 females) whose mothers had no co-morbidities, born at or visiting Navodaya Medical College Hospital in Raichur, Karnataka, India.
finding: Macronychia is common in the fingernails of newborns, while micronychia is more common in toenails, and koilonychia can be a physiological finding at birth.
cross-section timing: Mean age of 3 +/- 1.5 days after birth
